robot.name: g1-29dof-dex3
robot.asset_provenance: pinned SONIC gear_sonic G1 rev 1.0 Dex3 asset (sha256 a7a2bab7), materialized into the data root

table.asset_provenance: Unitree packing table from unitree_sim_assets (Isaac 4.5 Isaac/Props/PackingTable). Variant 2 is used because the PackingTable and PackingTable_1 copies carry a container_h20 resting on the worktop (measured 0.9926-1.0829 m), which would occupy the space the three cubes and the target need.
table.surface_height_provenance: Measured live on 2026-09-19 with the pose probe (src/humanoid_lab/simulators/isaac/pose_probe.py; record outputs/isaac-blockstacking-scene-polish/probe/current-profile.json), not derived. The probe commands both elbow joints to -0.32227265783984543 rad and reports that value as elbow_joint_commanded_rad; the per-hand write echo equals it by construction, because ArticulationData.joint_pos is a timestamped cache that a state write fills without advancing its timestamp, so the probe records it under that name instead of claiming it is a measurement. The articulation's realized readback of that pose -- root_physx_view.get_dof_positions(), reported as elbow_joint_realized_rad and as post_render_joint_readback_rad -- is -0.2932764589 rad (left) and -0.2931782007 rad (right), i.e. the elbow does not sit exactly at the commanded value and the two sides differ by 1e-4 rad. The 90 deg bend itself is measured from the live link positions (shoulder-yaw, elbow and wrist-roll link origins), not from a joint value: the asset's authored elbow frames solve to -0.2932327 rad for a perpendicular arm, applying that value measures 88.319 deg live, and the probe therefore refines the applied command until the measured upper-arm/forearm bend is 90.000 deg (left 90.0025, right 89.9969). The lowest world-z over all eight Dex3 links of each hand (palm, index, middle, thumb; mesh vertices transformed by the simulated link poses, because the stage prims keep the authored pose) is 0.8857629 m (left) and 0.8857609 m (right), both on the palm bottom; the shared lower value minus the 0.05 m cube size gives this surface, so table_surface + cube_size = lowest hand/finger world-z holds for both hands. The torso stays upright (waist joints zero) and both hands hang 2 um apart, so the common value is the safe one. Table root z is the surface minus the worktop offset 0.9940513 m above the asset origin (live worktop 0.8357609377640927 m, 3.8e-8 m below the declared surface; table asset bbox x 0.2190-1.0006, y +/-1.2368 in the same run). The older flexed4 record under outputs/isaac-blockstacking-calibration/elbow90/ belongs to the previous profile: its 0.6706 m scene was measured before the table was raised, and the current-profile record is the one named above. The runtime scene probe keeps reporting the live worktop, target and cube heights on every run.

cubes.diffuse_rgb_provenance: Rendered material override for the third (\"blue\") cube only; its identity, pose, size, mass and physics material are unchanged. Fixed method: (1) the third block's colour distribution in the BlockStacking training videos (observation.images.egocentric, 24 episodes sampled every 12th, six time fractions each, 136 frames) has a median blob-mean colour of (70.1, 123.5, 87.2) sRGB -- green, hue 69 on OpenCV's 0-179 scale, saturation 111, value 124; (2) the same statistic measured on this cube in the policy's own head camera during the 09-A campaign (162 frames, median blob-mean (74.6, 142.2, 215.0) sRGB) against its declared albedo (0.05, 0.20, 0.80) gives the simulator's per-channel render transfer k = (1.393, 1.356, 0.849); (3) the albedo that renders the demonstrated colour on the same cube slot is srgb_to_linear(target)/k = (0.044, 0.147, 0.113), rounded to three decimals. Nothing else in this profile differs from configs/profiles/isaac-g1-sonic-blockstacking-dex3.json, which is unchanged; the whole variant is opt-in (dev.sh psi0-isaac-eval --scene-profile).
